messages:
jamie: Morning — quick async handoff from overnight. What I did: triaged pager for redis-evict spike, rolled back kv-evict patch at 03:20 UTC, warmed a few shards. Root cause looks like eviction policy + larger batch requests.
liam: Thanks. Did rollback restore SLOs?
jamie: Yes, 5xxs dropped back under alert threshold within ~7m. Latency still a bit elevated on the 95th for short windows.
sarah: I left a comment on the rollback PR re: missing test for edge-case TTLs. PTAL jamie.
jamie: Saw it, will address today.
alex: For the elevated p95 — can you share the heatmap? Might be prefix cache warmup.
jamie: attaching small dump: ```redis-cli --stat 60\n# sample: hot shards showing high miss rate on prefix cache```
morgan: I'll follow up on autoscale policy. Noticed Dedicated pool had a small surge; autoscaler didn't add nodes fast enough. Opened ticket INF-3345.
liam: Noted INF-3345. Can we add a short-term mitigation rule to raise scale aggressiveness for cache-miss bursts?
morgan: Yep, proposal in the ticket: temporary lower CPU threshold to 55% for 30m windows.
jamie: Blockers: need an owner to validate the proposed autoscaler tweak and a quick rollback plan if it misbehaves.
alex: I can own validation — will run sim and smoke test by EOD.
sarah: Oncall follow-ups: paging noise on staging alert rule 'redis.eviction_rate' — I trimmed some noisy labels last night, but need to confirm no side effects.
jamie: Thanks. If you need me to repro the spike I can run the batched load script.
sarah: Could you run it in the canary shard and post results? mention @alex if you need telemetry tweaks.
jamie: Will do this morning.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation handoff at 09:00 UTC. New primary: liam.
liam: Ack. I'll monitor dashboards for the next 2 hours and watch INF-3345 progress.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: kv-evict-rollout v2.1 -> rolled back at 03:22 UTC (by jamie). No active deploys.
morgan: FYI — I'm syncing with infra to add a small dashboard widget for eviction rate vs prefix-cache hit %. Should help correlation.
liam: Anything for me to unblock today?
jamie: If you can ack INF-3345 and the autoscaler proposal, alex will validate. Also, please follow up with product that requested more aggressive memory usage — might need tradeoff doc.
liam: On it. I'll ping product and update the ticket.
sarah: I'll run the staging fuzz for TTL edge cases and post results here.
jamie: Thanks team. I'll run the canary load and add the missing test to PR. Ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
liam: LGTM. Thanks for the quick rollback and notes.
alex: I'll post sim results to INF-3345 when done.
morgan: Opening follow-up for telemetry improvements: INF-3346.
jamie: last note — leaving breadcrumbs in runbook under section 'kv-evict rollback' with the exact rollback command and smoke checks. Link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict>
liam: Perfect. Closing my loop here.
